textures.usedAs: Convenience-store interior behind the ground-floor glazing (17 bays alternate with the bakery, plus mirrored copies)
textures.inspection: Reads as a real late-night convenience store: clipped-in shelving, bottle rows, counter and customer, rain droplets and street reflections on the glass. Cool interior light against dark mullions matches the wet exterior.

textures.usedAs: Warm bakery / tea-shop interior for the remaining ground-floor bays
textures.inspection: Warm amber interior with counters and display cases, readable depth and glass reflections. Alternates cleanly with the cool convenience store.

textures.usedAs: Retired: its hotel-lobby interior did not match the real Guomao entrance
textures.inspection: Five-leaf lobby elevation: warm ceiling, marble floor reflections, reception desk, stairs and planting. Technically clean, but the reception desk and planting read as a hotel lobby, not the Guomao ground floor.

textures.references: prompts/entrance-wide-v004.txt — three real photographs of the entrance, listed in referencePhotos above
textures.usedAs: Single 12 m entrance banner behind the five glass leaves
textures.inspection: Flat elevation of five equal bronze-framed glass leaves between banded pink-granite piers, with a level transom and parallel verticals. Behind the glass is the real Guomao luxury ground floor: lit cosmetics counters, cream stone floor and a curved white ceiling, not a hotel desk. Night interior light stays below clipping, wet reflections sit on the outer leaves, and no readable text, logo or temporary banner is baked in.

textures.usedAs: Front panel of the two vending machines flanking the entrance
textures.inspection: Front-lit vending machine with can rows and a service panel; proportions are portrait, matching the 1:2 cabinet face.

textures.usedAs: Campaign artwork on the magenta media wall west of the entrance
textures.inspection: Backlit fashion campaign with a green cape on an orange field, framed by a dark billboard box. The warm field provides the pink/orange accent used by the wet-ground light pool.

textures.usedAs: Dot-matrix fill for the cyan crown band and the texture base of the 国贸 crown letters
textures.inspection: A curved tower facade covered in cyan and white LED dots at night. Used only for its dot structure: the letter panel keeps white glyphs and multiplies 20% of this image over them so the sign reads as a lit LED crown.

textures.inspection: Clean single-lobby view, but its portrait proportion repeated the doorway across the wide entrance. Kept as a version record; not referenced by the scene.
